notes: After a strong T1 (FoI steal) the Runner spent T1-T5 at 0 credits running HQ over and over while tagged by Behold!, never built a rig beyond Sang Kancil, then spent T6-T17 almost entirely on clicking for credits and paying to remove tags with 5 cards in grip. It made no attempt on the Server 1 card installed T12 and scored as Tomorrow's Headline T13, sat on 14-18 credits on T13-T14 doing nothing, and let the Corp go from 2 to 7 points unopposed.

Fast scoring of two Sericulture Expansions and two Yagi-Udas out of Server 1 was sensible, but the Corp spent everything on advancing and never had money to rez a single ice. On T6 it left a 2-advanced Fujii Asset Retrieval behind unrezzed ice at 1 credit against a 28-credit Runner and lost it, with R&D also open (Flower Sermon stolen). T9 was three credit clicks plus a discard.

T1 facecheck of Server 1 with 1 credit bounced off Akhet, then T5/T7/T8/T9 were four R&D runs each that could only re-see the same top card. From T10 to T17 the Runner clicked for credits every turn up to 39 credits with 5 cards in grip, never installing a barrier breaker or running. Transport Monopoly was scored out of Server 3 on T14 and again on T18 with no contest.

The Corp put two ice on R&D on T1 and never iced HQ, so the Runner took Architect Deployment Test T1, Project Ingatan T2 and three agendas T3 for a turn-3 loss. On T2 Sprint shuffled two cards back but kept Project Ingatan in open HQ, and on T3, with 13 credits, it drew three cards into an unprotected HQ instead of installing ice.

Good aggressive Sable play: Post-Truth stolen T1, Maintenance Access to HQ, an expensive but correct N-Pot break for Freedom of Information T4, Tomorrow's Headline T6, and Window of Opportunity to finish on Stoke the Embers T8. The only debatable move was facechecking R&D at about 4 credits on T3 into Piranhas, which cost Laser Pointer.

The T3 Architect Deployment Test score was nice, but the Corp repeatedly used Drafter installs to overwrite its own Nico and Otto Campaigns (T2, T5, T6, T11, T12). It left Méliès City Luxury Line behind only a Vertigo on T6-T7, where it was stolen. On T12 it Drafter-installed the second Méliès into Server 3, which the rich Runner (Marjanah and Cat's Cradle in play) took immediately; T10 and T11 went on credit clicks and Hedge Funds instead of advancing it.

Good early pressure stole Remastered Edition from Server 1 T2 and from R&D T3, and the R&D lock through Vasilisa eventually won T11. However, the Runner kept running Vasilisa every turn and paying 2 credits to clear each tag. It installed Dr. Nuka Vrolyck (T3) and Daily Casts (T7) while it had or was about to take tags, and both were trashed. T8 was spent drawing and installing Gauss with no run.

T1 facecheck of Server 1 with 1 credit hit Akhet, then on T2-T4 the Runner made four R&D runs per turn that mostly re-saw the same top card. From T5 to T14 it clicked for credits almost every turn up to 40 credits, never installing anything. It made just one run (T12, a Transport Monopoly steal undone by Divested Trust) while the Corp scored Transport Monopoly, Divested Trust and two more agendas out of a remote with one or two ice.

On T4 the Corp used Mitosis to put Sisyphus Protocol into a naked remote with 2 counters it could not score, and it was stolen. Archives was never iced after sabotage sent Lotus Haze and Hybrid Release there (stolen T6). After that the Corp sat at 0-5 credits clicking for credits and discarding (T8, T9, T11, T13). On T14 Longevity Serum trashed its whole HQ, including See How They Run, into open Archives with the Runner at 5 points, handing over the win.

It won, but the Corp floated 30-53 credits while clicking for credits most turns (T14, T15, T18, T20-T23) instead of building Server 8. Longevity Serum was left there behind only Bathynomus and Semak-samun, which the Runner broke cheaply, and was stolen twice (T19 and T25). Early naked Urtica and Bladderwort remotes and the Hybrid Release and Mitosis scores were fine.

Scoring out of Server 1 (Embedded Reporting T2, Tomorrow's Headline T6, two Post-Truth Dividends, Headline T12) was efficient. However, HQ stayed unprotected through T2, after the Runner had already run it three times on T1, and Next Big Thing was stolen from it. T7 went on three credit clicks with 8 credits and a full hand.

With no answer to Hammer the Runner kept running into it on HQ (T2, T3, three times on T4, T6, T7, T8, T10, T12, T17), taking a tag each time, losing Paladin Poemu, paying 2 per tag and staying at 0-4 credits all game. On T4 it ran HQ instead of the 2-advanced SDS Drone Deployment in Server 1, and it ended T12 at 0 credits with a tag, which set up the T13 Measured Response.

The Corp never iced R&D and spent T2-T5 on two Public Trails and repeated trashes of Daily Casts (three trash actions on T4 alone), dropping to 1 credit. The Runner then took two Embedded Reportings from open R&D on T4 and Next Big Thing from HQ on T5 for a turn-5 loss.

The Runner made repeated same-turn R&D runs that re-saw the same top card (T1-T5). On T2 it ignored the 2-advanced Fujii in Server 1, with 8 credits and unrezzed ice in the way, and it was scored T3. T9 went on installing a second unique Pennyshaver. On T12 it passed Diviner on Server 2 and then jacked out with a 2-advanced Fujii behind it, and that Fujii both won and flatlined it on T13.

Efficient central pressure: Project Yagi-Uda via Carpe Diem through Anemone T3, Hybrid Release from Archives T4, Fujii from HQ T5 and Longevity Serum T6 for the win. Running Anemone with a small grip on T3 cost three cards and the T1 Carpe Diem on an empty Archives was low-value, but it worked out.

Nico Campaigns went into naked remotes again and again (T1, T2, T7, T10) and were trashed for 2 each, which kept the Corp at 0-4 credits. Project Ingatan and Superconducting Hub were taken through a single unrezzed ice on R&D. Later the Corp sat on ice in HQ (Vertigo, Ablative Barrier, Drafter, Ansel seen there) while clicking for credits and discarding (T8, T11, T12, T14, T15), and lost to R&D digging behind one Ansel.

It won in the end, but slowly. Banner was lost to a T2 Ballista facecheck, many Archives runs hit an empty Archives (T3, T7, T10, T14, T16), and T8, T11 and T13 were mostly credit clicks while the Corp scored SDS T7 and Above the Law T10. Gachapon picks installed duplicate unique Cookbook (T17) and Fencer Fueno (T20), which were trashed, and Bling usage was odd. HQ pressure with Boi-tatá from T19 and Banner on Akhet finally found SDS T25.

T2, T4 and T5 were pure credit clicks with discards at end of turn, leaving 16 credits and nothing developed. On T8 Yagi-Uda went into Server 1 unadvanced next to two Hedge Funds and was stolen. Fujii Asset Retrieval ended up in unprotected Archives via the Corp's own Hafrún, AU Co. or Cultivate trashing and was stolen T9 to set up the loss.

Seamless Launch made the scoring efficient: Ingatan T3, Méliès T8, Ingatan T12. However, R&D stayed unprotected until T5 while the Runner ran it a dozen times, and the Corp hovered at 0-3 credits for most of the game. Naked Nicos were trashed (T4, T9), and the Corp just won the race before Megaprix-style R&D hits added up.

The Runner went to 0 credits on T1 (Unity plus Gauss), made repeated same-turn R&D runs that re-saw the same card (T1-T4), and ran the 2-advanced NBT server at 0 credits on T2. From T10 to T17 it clicked for credits to 38 with 5 cards in grip while the Corp built Server 4. On T18 and T20 it re-installed Gauss and ran into F2P (which bounced Gauss each time) and Paywall twice per turn, failing every time while Remastered Edition and Artificial Cryptocrash were scored.
